name: JORDAN VALE

summaries.text: Product manager with six years in clinic software, close to engineers and support teams.

bullets.text: Launched the billing product for 300 small clinics.
Grew weekly active clinics from 40 to 260 in two years by rebuilding onboarding, the appointment reminders and the billing exports that front desks used every single day.
Led a team of 40 engineers across three sites.
